description:
Seo-Kyung, who has had a crush on his childhood friend Jae-Ha for a long time, has lived his life believing that this love would never be reciprocated. Consumed by jealousy toward Jae-Ha, who was kind to everyone, Seo-Kyung even pretended to dislike him. Then one day, he came across a post on an anonymous college forum. 

*“Does anyone know the name of the guy working at the library starting at 1 PM on Fridays? He’s the textbook definition of a puppy face… He’s so handsome… If you know him, please send me a DM ㅜㅜ”*

Seo-Kyung, who didn’t even expect Jae-Ha, who turns heads wherever he goes, to notice him, falls asleep that night, in a fit of pique, imagining the childish fantasy that Jae-Ha might as well be a real dog. And when morning comes, an unidentified brown dog is sleeping right next to him. 

“No way… is this Cha Jae-Ha?”

Seo-Kyung’s desperate struggle to break the curse that turned his secret crush into a dog begins!

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

*Note: The seventh story in the Sachungi: Neoreul Saenggakaneun Bom (사춘기: 너를 생각하는 봄) Collection.*
